headline: Chest-high-ish fair-angle S, but onshore-leaning wind keeps it soft.
today: Fair-angle S at up to 2ft, short period, with morning SSW onshore then SW cross-on building to 10mph in the afternoon. Never really cleans up, so it's a mushy groveler day. Dawn is your least-bad window before the wind fills.

daysToWatch.note: Biggest of the stretch at up to 2.7ft, fair angle. Cross-on wind holds it back but early sessions before the afternoon SW ramp are worth it.
Up to 2.4ft with NNE offshore at dawn and light ENE morning — the cleanest window of the week. Get out early before the SE cross-on fills in.
Drops to 1.2ft and SSW goes onshore 12-14mph all day. Flat and blown — skip it.
